query: Across role, grade level, and subject, which open-response themes are associated with satisfaction?

per_column.name: subject_domain_affordance_for_remote
per_column.rationale: Well-separated ordinal categories (naturally/moderately/poorly suited) that segment responses and can be cross-tabulated against satisfaction and subject.

per_column.name: teacher_innovation_and_adaptation
per_column.rationale: Interpretable graded theme (highly creative to minimal effort) external to satisfaction; supports meaningful grouping comparisons.

per_column.name: student_interactive_participation_enabled
per_column.rationale: Clear three-level participation categories that are associational with satisfaction, not a restatement.

per_column.name: peer_community_and_social_learning
per_column.rationale: Distinct social-learning outcome categories with balanced counts; enables segmentation against the focus.

per_column.name: conceptual_depth_versus_compliance
per_column.rationale: Interpretable learning-depth spectrum, external to satisfaction and comparable across roles/subjects.

per_column.name: hands_on_practical_subject_constraint
per_column.rationale: Meaningful constraint categories that vary by subject; usable for grouped comparison though dominated by not_present.

per_column.name: student_attention_and_focus_capacity
per_column.rationale: Interpretable engagement categories associated with satisfaction; well-separated segments.

per_column.name: parent_partnership_intensity_and_burden
per_column.rationale: Conceptually valid theme but heavily dominated by not_present (180), leaving thin, near-constant categories that weaken comparison.

per_column.name: teacher_workload_and_emotional_toll
per_column.rationale: Interpretable workload/wellbeing categories; skewed toward not_present but retains usable distinct segments.

judge.rationale: The added columns are open-response themes coded into interpretable, well-separated categorical scales that are external and associational to satisfaction, not restatements of the 1-5 score. They can be grouped and cross-segmented against role, grade level, and subject, directly serving correlational/exploratory analysis. Values are human-readable and not opaque scores. Minor weaknesses: several columns are skewed toward 'not_present' (notably parent_partnership and teacher_workload), which reduces comparison power in those thin cells, and some category labels overlap conceptually across columns. Overall this is a strong, purpose-built EDA set.
